content.short: Stabil Finance compounds yield across HyperEVM lending, liquidity and staking positions.
content.description: Stabil Finance is a yield aggregator where users stake tokens to compound APR into APY automatically. Its zap functions move capital in and out of positions, including LP-to-LP swaps that avoid unwinding to the underlying assets first. The protocol runs on Cronos EVM and zkEVM alongside its Hyperliquid deployment.
content.meta: Automated compounding that turns advertised HyperEVM rates into realised returns.
